notes:
Kokoro now reads three times faster.

It turns out the smaller version of Kokoro was the reason it was slow. Swapping it for the full-size one takes it from about nine seconds a line to under three — fast enough to read along live instead of only playing back chapters you prepared first.

The trade is the download: 305 MB instead of 98. It is the largest voice here by some way, so it asks first and it is best done on Wi-Fi. If you already had Kokoro installed, the old copy is removed automatically and you will be asked before anything is fetched.

Kokoro can also cast characters now. Its eleven voices have been measured properly, and they turn out to be further apart than the ones BEST uses — so a page with several people talking has more room to give them different voices.

Also in this release: the voice screen now says "unpacking" while it unpacks, instead of sitting at 100% for several minutes looking stuck. A download that fails after every retry now says so. And a failed install no longer leaves a few hundred megabytes behind.

BEST is still the default and still the fastest.
